verdict.rationale: Decagon's MCP blog post (decagon-docs-3) discusses using MCP to curate/scope tool access for its own agents (i.e., Decagon as an MCP client consuming external tools), not exposing an official MCP server that lets an external AI agent connect into Decagon. No documentation, endpoint, or announcement of a first-party Decagon MCP server was found, and the OpenAPI/spec probes returned 404s with no MCP-specific server mentioned.
